```prolog
:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- use_module(library(charsio)).
:- use_module(library(dcg/basics)).

main :-
    current_input(In),
    read_line_to_codes(In, Line),
    Line \== end_of_file,
    phrase(numbers(Line, [A, B]), _),
    A >= 1, B >= 1,
    gcd(A, B, G),
    L is (A // G) * B,
    format("~d~n~d~n", [G, L]).

numbers([], []) --> [].
numbers(L, Ns) --> whites, number(N), !, { append(Cs, Rest, L), phrase((number(N), Rest), Cs) }.
```

:- module(main, [main/0]).

main :-
    current_input(In),
    read_line_to_codes(In, Line),
    Line \== end_of_file,
    split(Line),
    true.

split(Line) :-
    append(Codes, [0'\n|_], Line), !,
    parse(Codes).
split(Line) :-
    parse(Line).

parse(Codes) :-
    append(Acodes, [0' | Bcodes], Codes), !,
    number_codes(A, Acodes),
    number_codes(B, Bcodes),
    solve(A, B).
parse(Codes) :-
    number_codes(A, Codes),
    peek_char(B) % placeholder
    ; true.

solve(A, B) :-
    gcd(A, B, G),
    L is (A // G) * B,
    format("~d~n~d~n", [G, L]).

gcd(A, 0, A) :- !.
gcd(A, B, G) :-
    R is A mod B,
    gcd(B, R, G).
